summary: Two hikers diverted off the S-Ridge of Snowmass Mountain by lightning became cliffed out on the west face, spent the night cold/wet but uninjured, and were lowered from the cliff by Crested Butte Mountain Rescue
notes: reported mid-August 2017; date approx per mission narrative
wx_note: ERA5 archive 0.25° grid (Open-Meteo); coord basis: peak (Snowmass Mountain)
